title: Bounds on median eigenvalues of graphs of bounded degree
summary: We prove that for every integer $d \ge 3$, the median eigenvalues of any graph of maximum degree $d$ are bounded above by $\sqrt{d-1}$. We also prove that, in three separate cases, the median eigenvalues of a graph of maximum degree $d$ are bounded below by $-\sqrt{d-1}$: when the graph is triangle-free, when $d-1$ is a perfect square, or when $d \ge 75$. These results resolve, for all but finitely many values of $d$, an open problem of Mohar on median eigenvalues of graphs of maximum degree $d$.
